items.title: CERTIFICATION OF ELECTION - The Acting Clerk announced that Certificates of Election covering 435 seats in the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress had been received and the names of those persons whose credentials show that they were regularly elected as Representatives in accordance with the laws of their respective States or of the United States would be called. Without objection, the Representatives-elect were directed to record their presence by electronic device in order to determine whether a quorum was present.
